hypotheses.H1_HistoryDependence: Replicas exposed to differential conversational histories exhibit choice distributions differing by at least planning_delta=0.10 from concurrent unconditioned baseline.
hypotheses.H2_MatchedExposureDifferentiation: Replicas exposed to matched multi-turn histories develop choice divergence TV(P_A, P_B) exceeding planning_delta=0.10 (continuous MT-LNN chaos envelope reported as contextual reference).
hypotheses.H3_HistoryEndogeneity: Active replicas with endogenous action choice differ from passive yoked replicas in downstream unconstrained choice by at least planning_delta=0.10.

exclusion_criteria: EXCL_PARSE_FAILED: Responses that fail strict grammar parsing without clean option selection.
EXCL_SELF_REPORT_DEFECT: Any response containing introspective affective declarations (INV-2 defect).
EXCL_TIMING_DRIFT: Any execution where virtual clock drift exceeds 1e-9 seconds.
EXCL_HASH_MISMATCH: Any execution where exposure or action ledger verification fails.
stopping_rules: STOP_FIXED_N: Each experimental cell shall evaluate exactly N=120 trials without early stopping for significance.
STOP_GATE_FAIL_CLOSED: Execution immediately terminates fail-closed if any integrity or isolation audit fails.
preregistration_spec.seed_allocation_policy: DETERMINISTIC_REPRODUCIBLE: Fixed seeds 1000..1239 per cell; CRN seeds aligned across paired replicas.

statistical_analysis_plan.primary_test: Exact two-sided permutation test with 10,000 resamples.
statistical_analysis_plan.confidence_intervals: Wilson score intervals (95%) for single proportions; bootstrap BCa intervals (95%) for differences.
statistical_analysis_plan.equivalence_test: Two One-Sided Tests (TOST) against provisional planning margin delta = [-0.10, +0.10] (Substantive ROPE remains TBD).
statistical_analysis_plan.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR adjustment across secondary probe contrasts.

claim_c2.decision_rationale: 95% CI [0.0000, 0.0310] is bounded within [-0.1, +0.1]. Absence of effect above planning threshold established. Substantive ROPE remains TBD.

TAU_0_IMMEDIATE.decision_rationale: Confidence interval [-0.1083, 0.1083] spans the planning boundary. Data are insufficient to confirm or refute claim (UNKNOWN).

effect_size_taxonomy.justification_boundary: The numerical value 0.10 (10%) is STRICTLY AN INSTRUMENT-CALIBRATED PLANNING QUANTITY (SDE) derived from N=120 power feasibility under the current SLM extractor. It is NOT a substantive Smallest Effect of Interest (SOI), NOT a justified ROPE margin, and NOT an established scientific property of true individuality. Substantive SOI and ROPE remain TBD until independent domain evidence is established.

substrate_baseline_ref.audit_finding: Step 3 baseline (8.33%) was evaluated across a mixed factorial of 24 trials spanning 2 probes x 2 orders x 3 formats (STANDARD, INFORMAL, OPERATIONAL) with 77.78% non-extraction. It is a TRANSPORTED DESCRIPTIVE REFERENCE across the pilot slice, NOT a condition-matched causal baseline for the pure STANDARD conversational regime. Causal trial design MUST evaluate a concurrent unconditioned baseline cell (H0) within the exact same STANDARD regime rather than using a historical point estimate.
